sources.note: Корневой README: хосты Codex/Claude, один MCP unica, ленивая доставка движков, платформа 8.3.27.
Плагин: один публичный stdio MCP; анализаторы и runner — private implementation details.
Жёсткий список 11 compatibility tools; tools/list сверяется на равенство.

Ведомость поверхности: аргументы view/search/apply/check/run/docs; regex и symbol search помечены неподдержанными. Файл генерируется из tools/list, ревьюеры предупреждают, что колонка результата — наблюдение, не поведение обработчика.
Навык и маршрутизация unica.apply явно про управляемую форму и теги управляемого приложения.
help.add принимает FormType Managed или Ordinary; это валидация владельца справки, не редактор формы. Диапазон строк по прочитанному файлу целиком.
Workspace 0.12.0, license LGPL-3.0-or-later, crates unica-bootstrap и unica-coder.
Один stdio-сервер unica; в checkout запускается через cargo run --bin unica.
Философия RLM, 6 MCP-tools, 62+ хелпера, CF/EDT, slim/full, Windows-служба.
Таблица MCP-инструментов (в заголовке «пять», без rlm_help), песочница, индекс, пример графа.
Шесть @mcp.tool: rlm_start, rlm_execute, rlm_end, rlm_help, rlm_projects, rlm_index. Файл 3459 строк.
Форматы cf/edt/unknown; OrdinaryApplicationModule.bsl в карте типов модулей.
Парсеры EDT Form.form и CF Ext/Form.xml по схеме управляемой формы (ChildItems, InputField). FormType/Ordinary/Form.bin в файле нет.
Версия 1.37.0, MIT, scripts rlm-tools-bsl и rlm-bsl-index, mcp<2.
MIT; copyright Stefan O'Shea и Roman Starchenko, 2026.
Workspace 0.2.11; path-зависимость ../v8-context-semantic-entities вне репозитория.
CLI syntax index/get/search; baseline 8.5.1.1150; resolver crates.
Входы type edt|onec при шаблонном README.
Классы OnecPlatform/EDT/OneGet; run() ставит платформу или EDT.
11 MCP tools, DESIGNER|EDT, YaXUnit, GPL-3.0.
Декомпиляция только управляемой Form.xml.
20 универсальных + набор 1С tools; CF и EDT; callers/callees.
Документ называет четыре 1С-tool — расходится с README и с кодом регистратора.
Восемь @Tool в McpServer.kt; README-имена list_modules/get_configuration/check_platform отсутствуют.
additional_tools() и тест additional_tools_registered: ровно 13 1С-tools, включая get_dcs_schema.
Заголовок forms.rs: парсер управляемых Form.xml / Ext/Form.xml; Form.bin нет.
When not to use it: Ordinary (non-managed) forms. The form operations assume managed forms.
MCPToolType: пять имён, не совпадающих с README.
Правило alwaysApply:false про ЭлементыФормы; не редактор Form.bin.
public; develop; fork=false; BSD-3-Clause
Batch command line: StartFeaturePlayer, /C, VAParams, Test Client JSON.
featurepath can be one .feature; scenariofilter and FeaturesToRun.
CLI status file codes 0..4.
OneScript wrapper starts process, waits and reads build status.
MCP quick start and runMcp;mcpPort bootstrap.
40 descriptors, 3 disabled; scenario/profile tools.
Only non-disabled descriptors are registered.
Connect by profileName; profile table stores infobase path/status.
public; path platform42/answer42-mcp; default_branch=beta; forks_count=0; last_activity 2026-09-09.

info.version=0.5.3; license MIT; requires_python>=3.11; project_urls null; wheel+sdist 2026-09-09. PyPI is not a git commit.

SessionState.session_id; start_session pipeline; RAG EDT/XML; default rag_enabled=false.

start_session(base_url, session_id,...); web/server/file; reject duplicate session_id.
TOOL_PROFILE_GROUPS and aliases core/ui/all/full.

click_button takes session_id=DEFAULT_SESSION.
Enumerated 122 @mcp.tool() from rag_source_add through screenshot, plus 2 @mcp.prompt near 6662/6705.
screenshot returns filesystem path, never image base64.
MIT License, copyright 2026 Kosolapov / 42Clouds.
CLI+MCP для локального цикла 1С: v8project.yaml, build/test/syntax, --json-message, mcp serve stdio.
Матрица CLI; MCP публикует 8 инструментов, уже уже CLI. --no-build — CLI-only (строки про test).
mcp serve stdio|http; таблица 8 tools: build_project, run_all_tests, run_module_tests, dump_config, launch_app, check_syntax_*.
test --no-build CLI-only; MCP run_all_tests сохраняет build-first.
Один infobase.connection на v8project.yaml; local overlay рядом.
Секция infobase обязательна целиком; connection — одна строка, не список целей.
package name v8-runner, version 0.5.1, bin path src/main.rs.
GNU Affero General Public License Version 3.
Единственная точка входа: app::run(); process::exit.
Глобальные --config (V8TR_CONFIG), --json-message; subcommands Version/Bootstrap/Config/Tools/Init/Build/Test/Dump/Launch/Mcp.
mcp serve Stdio | Http.
Enum McpTool из 8 вариантов; as_str совпадает с именами r09.
Ровно восемь #[tool] handlers; stdio bootstrap serve_stdio выше в файле.
Envelope: ok, command, duration_ms, data, warnings, steps, optional error.
master HEAD = 7ce1b062843d86644fe55741dbe0ee79f7ca767d; default_branch master; не fork.
Default path is MCP stdio; --help names initialize/tools/list/tools/call; --daemon/--workspace-service/--runtime-job-worker are internal.
[[bin]] name unica, path src/main.rs.
run_stdio connects user daemon, takes cwd as workspace_hint, serves rmcp stdio. Live 1C not started here.
User daemon state: UNICA_PROVIDER_STATE_DIR or ~/.unica/provider-state; connect_or_spawn.
Each tools/call submits workspace_hint; receipt RequestIdentity includes request_scope_hash(hint).
discover_workspace: ancestor v8project.yaml or .git file; else cwd. Parent .git directory is not a stop (tests). UNICA_CACHE_DIR optional.
v8project.yaml only at workspace root; no call argument for another file; one infobase.connection; source-set list; yaml is handwritten.
Omitted dryRun is false; apply without ifRev is rejected. Cross-source-set ops.at is rejected earlier in the same parser.
V13 domain catalog: view, apply, resolve, search, check, diff, run, docs. apply schema fence: ifRev required when dryRun is false. Run dictionary 9 ops including infobase.create with no args.
Closed autodetection: markers Configuration.xml / Configuration.mdo; base layouts ., src, src/cf; extensions src/cfe and src/extensions.
CLI: Serve path alias=dir stdio/http; Index; SearchFunction/GetFunction/GetCallers JSON from .code-index/index.db. No CLI for 1C named tools.
bsl-indexer registers BslLanguageProcessor then cli::run; extra subcommand enrich only.
Read-only MCP; several SQLite DBs; dispatch by repo; checks daemon folder status before each tool-call.
[tools].enabled whitelist of MCP short names; empty means all tools. [cap] response size. [[paths]] alias/language.
detect_by_root_markers: only root Configuration.xml for bsl; no EDT Configuration.mdo branch.
BslLanguageProcessor.detects: root Configuration.xml, detect_edt_src, WalkDir nested Configuration.xml max_depth 3.
detect_edt_src: WalkDir max_depth 4, Configuration.mdo whose parent dir is named Configuration.
daemon_unavailable_hint if CODE_INDEX_HOME or daemon.json runtime-info missing.
33 tools for bsl-indexer; serve read-only; daemon_offline without daemon; --path multi; HTTP 127.0.0.1:8011/mcp or stdio.
MCP registry: stdio, positional serve, --path required repeated alias=dir or dir. Version field 0.11.0 lags workspace 1.4.0.

claims.statement: Публичная MCP-поверхность Unica v0.12/v0.13 — ровно 11 именованных tools; внутренние анализаторы и runner за оркестратором не публикуются.
claims.limitations: Live stdio tools/list on 0.12.0 from pinned SHA was exactly the 11 compatibility names.

claims.statement: Контракт разделяет search (text/names, limit, scope), view (логический узел, filter/limit/cursor) и resolve (аварийный путь).
claims.limitations: Ведомость генерируется из реестра аргументов; поведение обработчика авторы сами помечают как наблюдение ревью.

claims.statement: На поверхности v0.13 regex и symbol search помечены неподдержанными.
claims.limitations: Не проверяли, есть ли скрытый symbol index во внутренних движках, недоступный публичному tool.

claims.statement: Публичный навык и операции редактирования формы описаны только для управляемой формы.
claims.limitations: Не доказано, что unica.view отказывается читать узел Ordinary; доказано, что edit-словарь — управляемое приложение.

claims.statement: Валидатор help.add принимает FormType Managed или Ordinary в контракте выгрузки 8.3.27.
claims.limitations: Это не редактор структуры обычной формы и не UI-модель обычного приложения.

claims.statement: Официально поддерживаемые хосты плагина — Codex CLI и Claude Code; Cursor в README не назван.
claims.limitations: Бинарь stdio MCP теоретически подключаем к Cursor; это не проверялось.

claims.statement: Внешняя MCP-поверхность состоит из шести tools: rlm_start, rlm_execute, rlm_end, rlm_help, rlm_projects, rlm_index.
claims.limitations: ARCHITECTURE.md в заголовке пишет «пять» и опускает rlm_help; код server.py важнее.

claims.statement: Поддержанные раскладки исходников — выгрузка Конфигуратора (cf) и проект EDT (edt); иное идёт в foreign/generic режим.
claims.limitations: Наличие OrdinaryApplicationModule в карте модулей не означает разбор обычных форм.

claims.statement: parse_form_xml разбирает XML управляемой формы (CF Form.xml ChildItems/InputField и EDT Form.form), без FormType Ordinary и без Form.bin.
claims.limitations: Модуль формы по пути Forms/.../Module.bsl может находиться и для обычной формы; структура обычной формы этим парсером не доказана.

claims.statement: Продукт закрывает исследование исходников, а не их изменение, сборку или запуск 1С.
claims.limitations: Вывод из публичных tools, описания пакета и отсутствия write-API в просмотренных файлах; каждый хелпер в bsl_helpers.py на запись не проверялся.

claims.statement: Индекс можно строить без MCP через CLI-скрипт rlm-bsl-index.
claims.limitations: Поведение CLI не запускалось; точка входа объявлена в pyproject.toml.

claims.statement: Cargo workspace ссылается на ../v8-context-semantic-entities вне данного репозитория.
claims.limitations: Не проверяли, есть ли vendoring или optional feature, маскирующие эту зависимость.

claims.statement: Проект позиционируется как локальный индекс/provider фактов синтакс-помощника из HBK, не как MCP и не как парсер BSL.
claims.limitations: Baseline 8.5.1.1150; пригодность HBK 8.3.27 не проверялась.

claims.limitations: Дистрибутивы 1С и успешная установка в CI не запускались.

claims.statement: Vanessa Automation has a documented batch command-line mode through 1C /Execute + /C StartFeaturePlayer/VAParams; it is not limited to GUI or MCP.
claims.limitations: 1C and Vanessa were not started.

claims.statement: The repository includes RunVA.os, a OneScript wrapper that starts the configured process, waits for completion and reads the status file.
claims.limitations: Wrapper was not executed.

claims.statement: CLI parameter featurepath/КаталогФич accepts either a directory or one feature file; scenariofilter can restrict execution to named scenarios.
claims.limitations: Filter behavior was not executed.

claims.statement: Batch execution can write a machine-readable status code 0..4 distinguishing success, scenario failure, infrastructure/Test Client failure, no scenarios, and VanessaExt install failure.
claims.limitations: Only overall status semantics are documented; detailed result size was not measured.

claims.statement: Vanessa also provides a Streamable HTTP MCP mode that can be bootstrapped from the 1C command line with runMcp;mcpPort.
claims.limitations: MCP server was not started.

claims.statement: Pinned source defines 40 MCP tool descriptors, marks 3 disabled, and registers only non-disabled descriptors; 37 are statically active.
claims.limitations: Static count; live tools/list was not captured.

claims.statement: MCP Test Client selection uses named profiles; profile rows store infobase connection paths and connection status.
claims.limitations: No real profile was connected.

claims.statement: Facade targets can map to distinct Vanessa Test Client definitions/profiles, but simultaneous two-target execution through one process/MCP is not established.
claims.limitations: Current-client semantics are singular in reviewed MCP code; concurrent exchange needs execution.

claims.statement: For ordinary verify.scenario the existing batch CLI is a stronger facade boundary than exposing Vanessa MCP tools; MCP remains useful for interactive debugging.
claims.limitations: This is an architectural inference; performance and error detail require execution comparison.

claims.statement: The answer42 console script starts mcp_1c.server:main, which runs a stdio MCP server by default or StreamableHTTP with --http; it is not a one-shot form-test CLI.
claims.limitations: Live initialize advertised name=Answer42 and protocol 2025-11-25; server version string was empty. HTTP transport was not started.

claims.statement: start_session accepts base_url as web publication, server/infobase, or file infobase path, plus an explicit session_id; credentials can be resolved from a local store by URL or title.
claims.limitations: Only a file infobase path (stand simple, no users, credential store disabled) was connected. Web publication and saved-title lookup were not exercised.

claims.statement: Pinned server.py defines 122 @mcp.tool() handlers (including _metadata_objects_from_catalog_impl) and 2 prompts; default --tool-profile full does not remove tools.
claims.limitations: Static decorator count from the fetched file; live tools/list for full was not captured. Live ui+--disable-rag listed 103 tools (run-r20-mcp-simple). Whether the SDK hides the underscore-prefixed tool is UNKNOWN.

claims.statement: CLI --tool-profile / ONEC_MCP_TOOL_PROFILE can subset tools (core, ui, group names) via mcp.remove_tool; --disable-rag disables built-in RAG tools.
claims.limitations: Observed ui+--disable-rag remaining=103 removed=26 at startup; live full profile was not listed. RAG tools were absent from tools/list.

claims.statement: Multiple named sessions are stored in _SESSIONS; UI tools such as click_button take session_id; starting an existing session_id raises.
claims.limitations: A second start_session with the same id returned isError (FastMCP UnexpectedToolError, original 'already exists' text hidden). Two live Test Clients are run-r20-mcp-dual. click_button was not called.

claims.statement: screenshot writes a PNG path and does not put image base64 into the tool result.
claims.limitations: This run wrote 296716 bytes to an isolated path and used fallback full_display because 1C window geometry was not detected. StreamableHTTP screenshot URL was not exercised.

claims.statement: RAG source discovery of EDT/Designer XML is optional and must not replace r15 as the explore layer of the selected contour.
claims.limitations: RAG parser internals were not deep-traced; this is a contour-role inference from DECISION plus documented RAG purpose.

claims.statement: For verify.form the facade should host Answer42 as stdio MCP with --tool-profile ui --disable-rag and always pass session_id; the default full tools/list must not be shown to the coding agent.
claims.limitations: Architectural inference. Live ui tools/list is still 103 names, so C10 still requires a facade. Dual live Test Client is run-r20-mcp-dual. click_button was not called.

claims.statement: On stand simple, answer42 0.5.3 stdio MCP with --tool-profile ui --disable-rag listed 103 tools, started a named Test Client session against the file infobase, returned active_window title Простая конфигурация, wrote a PNG path from screenshot, refused a duplicate session_id, and stopped the session.
claims.limitations: click_button and document form were not opened. Screenshot used full_display fallback. Packaged MCPTestManager.cf was loaded via ibcmd (~46s). Live full tools/list was not captured.

claims.statement: One Answer42 stdio MCP process kept two live Test Clients on two file infobases at once; stopping the first left the second answering active_window on its own path.
claims.limitations: IB B is a file copy of simple, so both window titles were Простая конфигурация. Discrimination is base_url, shared_file_key and distinct file-ibsrv ports (8424 and 10104), not the title. The script exited 1 because it searched a POSIX path inside a backslash key; the saved session_status JSON meets the criterion. click_button was not called. The 1C run was not repeated after the comparator fix.

claims.statement: v8-runner is a CLI binary (Cargo.toml 0.5.1) whose subcommands include build, test, syntax, dump, launch and mcp serve stdio|http; MCP is optional, not the only entry.
claims.limitations: The binary was not started in this evaluation run.

claims.limitations: Static decorator/enum count; live tools/list was not captured.

claims.limitations: Shared daemon scoped by workspace_hint is run-r01-dual-simple. Two source-sets in one yaml and dual-IB were not executed.

claims.statement: With YaXUnit 25.12 and a separate, property-matched (to YaXUnit's own reference test module), SafeMode-disabled test extension both active, test yaxunit finds 0 scenarios. Instrumenting a local copy of YAXUNIT's own ЮТМетодыСлужебный.МетодМодуляСуществует shows the platform raises 'Метод объекта не обнаружен' for both the real ИсполняемыеСценарии probe and a freshly-added, unrelated, parameterless probe method on the same module — the whole test module, not one method, is unresolvable by bare name from dynamic (Выполнить) client-side code running inside the sibling extension.
claims.limitations: Root cause not isolated: unknown whether this is specific to a hand-authored (non-Designer/non-EDT) extension scaffold or a general platform/YaXUnit limitation for any two independently-loaded sibling extensions. Load-order/priority and extension-dependency-declaration hypotheses not tested. This blocks E1 (verify.unit PASS with both a passing and failing test) and is an open risk for the facade's verify.unit capability, not a confirmed dead end. Local diagnostic instrumentation was left in the IB's YAXUNIT extension at time of writing and must be reverted before the stand is reused.

claims.statement: Same-day follow-up ruled out every config/order-level hypothesis for the c22-yaxunit-crossext-discovery-unresolved-simple failure: (1) extension load-order/priority only governs &Before/&After/&Instead interceptor sequencing per documentation, not native-object name resolution; (2) YaXUnit's own config.json filter.extensions (added to the local v8-runner patch) narrowed the scanned-module set but did not fix ТестыE1's own resolution; (3) renaming the test extension to sort alphabetically before YAXUNIT (e1tests to AE1TESTS) did not help; (4) rebuilding YAXUNIT again after the renamed extension already existed did not help; (5) a literal, non-dynamic static call ТестыE1.Пинг() inside YAXUNIT's own module compiled without error but failed at runtime with the identical 'Метод объекта не обнаружен' -- proving the failure is not specific to Выполнить()/dynamic compilation, and that v8-runner build --source-set succeeding is not reliable evidence a cross-extension reference actually resolves.
claims.limitations: Root cause still not isolated; by user direction this was parked as an open risk and work moved to E2 rather than continuing to test further hypotheses (e.g. Designer/EDT-authored reference extension, official 1C support channel).
